hook: Parade Grounds wall work speeds up for *18-km* Shamirpet flyover
hook_b: Parade Grounds wall work speeds up for *18-km* Shamirpet flyover
tldr: HMDA has sped up a retaining wall near the Martyrs' Memorial at Parade Grounds for the Paradise-Shamirpet elevated corridor on Rajiv Rahdari.

beats.what: HMDA is relocating two memorials, the WWII memorial and Veerula Sainik Smarak, after Cantonment Board approval; land up to 20 m from the road is being acquired.
beats.why: The six-lane corridor is meant to bypass bottlenecks at Karkhana, Trimulghery, Bolarum, Alwal, Hakimpet and more.
beats.care: Expect construction slowdowns on the Paradise-Gymkhana-Shamirpet stretch while works run.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The new memorial platform is due by December; the new Rs 5 crore memorial is set for March-April 2027.

cards.q: How bad is your commute on Rajiv Rahdari right now?

qs: Which junctions on the stretch will change during construction?
Where will the cleared trees be compensated?

facts.t: The corridor is *six-lane*, Paradise Junction to ORR Shamirpet.

viz.verdict: Works will run for about two years

watch: Corridor is targeted for completion within 24 months.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Retaining wall work speeds up near Martyrs' Memorial at Secunderabad Parade Grounds

fact: Secunderabad's Martyrs' Memorial will move for an *18.18-km* elevated corridor
twist: Decades-old trees and landscaped lawns near the memorial were cleared for the retaining wall.
